parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet frame is the main structural body of the storage cabinet, made of plywood panels forming the sides, back, and top.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural support and stability for the entire cabinet, holding the door, drawer, and base in place.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part that supports other components.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet base is the bottom platform of the cabinet, made of plywood, supporting the weight of stored items and the structure above.
parts.Functional_description: It distributes the load evenly and provides a stable foundation for the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is a stationary part that does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: The cabinet door is a front panel made of MDF, attached to the frame with hinges, allowing access to the storage space inside.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the cabinet’s interior and conceals stored items when closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about its hinges to open and close.

parts.name: Drawer
parts.Basic_description: The drawer is a sliding storage compartment made of MDF, located at the top section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows for easy access to smaller items and provides organized storage space.
parts.Movement_description: It slides in and out along metal or wooden rails.
